rationale: Operator-selected release ratchets for the current corpus: strict enough to catch material search regressions while allowing normal ranking variance below a perfect score. RECALL is unchanged. NDCG was re-calibrated from 0.99 to 0.97 on 2026-09-27 under the owner's delegation of that date, after the gate measured NDCG@10 0.9735 where the same 24 cases had measured 0.9967: audit F-001 RULING-2 moved the last 288 redistributable rows to link-only, which removed the +0.15 rights-based availability boost that contracts/search-config.ts used to add, and an independent ranker-blind re-adjudication (outputs/audit-2026-09-26/p3-3-blind-judging/) confirmed the resulting order is genuinely worse for two of the 24 cases. 0.99 was calibrated against the boosted ranker, so this is a calibration change with a named cause and NOT a claim that search quality is unchanged. The value is chosen by the original method: the round two-decimal figure just below the measured aggregate (0.99 was chosen against 0.9967). A relevance fix remains outstanding as a defect (gate-found F-011); when it lands, raise this value rather than leaving it here.
